highlights: Participants made slides for "Your Place in War Week History".
The War Week finale doubled as the annual company meeting: a Saturday breakfast at The Stockade Inn, with family and friends welcome.
Presentations became optional: everyone chose a presentation, a technical or non-technical project, a Betterment of JG project, a War Week event or a push on billable work.
Joshua Cantor-Stone was crowned Lord of Catan at a 20-player Settlers of Catan night.
The first-ever JG Hidden Talent Show (and Tell), headlined by Chadd's own keyboard composition with fog machine and lasers.
International Day brought 33 dishes from 11 countries; Grandma's Perogies won best dish and Jason Jahnel won the outfit challenge.
Michael Shirk won Code Wars by finishing all four kata first, ahead of Jakub Synowiec and Jason Musits.
